item.title: Desolating Destiny
item.description:
As I rot in this AirBnb from the last two days, I realise how time flies when you’re not intentionally constructive towards something. It’s the same reason why I don’t remember much from my holidays at home. And why time just vanishes over there.

When you don’t understand the urgency and the gravity of the fact that your time in this world is limited, it’s really easy to waste away your prime years. To put to perspective, they say the perceived midpoint of one’s life is at eighteen, considering they live till eighty-one. That means you’ve basically lived half your life when you’re eighteen. And you have even less time from eighteen to forty, which is where the peak of your life lies.

item.title: My Current Workout Split
item.description:
I follow a Push, Pull, Leg split.
If you’re here to learn as a beginner, I’d redirect you to here.

Push

  • Chest: Barbell Bench Press
  • Side Delts: Lateral Raises (Cable/Dumbbell)
  • Tricep: Pushdown, Overhead Extensions (both Cable)

Pull

  • Back: Wide grip Pulldown, Barbell Bent Over Row
  • Bicep: Curls, Hammer Curls (both Cable)
  • Rear Delts: Reverse Pec Deck

Legs

  • Quads: Squats
  • Hammies: Leg Curl

The way I structure my week is;
Push, Pull, Leg, Rest.
And then I repeat.

item.title: Fix your attention span
item.description:
A summary to this video by @aevytv.

Why to fix attention?

The ability to focus, be creative, and being bored are innate to human beings and probably the very reasons they are powerful. If we lose our ability to channel our attention, we risk losing all these qualities that make us interesting and useful, and that’s no bueno.
It makes doing simple low dopamine tasks like reading books, going through an assignment, even working out a great challenge to push through.
Personally, I would like myself better if I’m more productive and consuming media consciously.

item.description:
I’d recommend everyone to watch these at least once in their lifetimes.

42 (2013)

added on 07 Feb, 2025

The story of the baseball legend Jackie Robinson’s journey starting out in the MLB, highlighting the racism in the sport. All the leads have done phenomenal acting, and this is a movie you won’t forget anytime soon.

Fun fact - This is the movie that earned Chadwick Boseman his role as Black Panther, and rightfully so. May he rest in peace.
